title: Inspection Findings and the Emergency Dispatch Charge — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
What the inspection found on the dispatched item sets the finding multiplier of the emergency dispatch charge under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, applied to the program's emergency dispatch fee in the scheduled dispatch charge.

**Rule.** The finding multiplier follows the inspection finding on the dispatched item: a condition the technician could not reproduce takes 0.50; a homeowner maintenance item takes 0.75; any other finding (homeowner damage, a homeowner alteration or a condition not covered) takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Finding recorded at the inspection of the dispatched item | Finding multiplier |
|---|---|
| not reproduced | 0.50 |
| maintenance item | 0.75 |
| homeowner damage | 1.00 |
| homeowner alteration | 1.00 |
| not covered | 1.00 |

The finding read is the latest inspection finding recorded for the dispatched claim item.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A technician is sent to a reported sewer backup and the inspection records a maintenance item; the multiplier is 0.75.
